meta.title: BitOrbit — Launch showcase, out 5 March 2027
meta.description: Launch showcase for BitOrbit, a four-player co-op rover game: one shared rover, four seats, 20-minute sorties, drop-in from a Discord link. Demo proof, wishlist growth, price and release date.

slides.eyebrow: BitOrbit · Launch showcase · On Steam 5 March 2027
slides.heading: Four friends, one rover, twenty minutes to escape orbit.
slides.lead: A co-op game you can finish before the pizza arrives.
slides.notes: Read the headline like a trailer card. Then go straight to the quote.

slides.quote: Our group spends 40 minutes in lobbies and menus to get 20 minutes of actual play.
slides.by: Reply to our Discord poll of 2,100 co-op players, May 2026

slides.heading: This is BitOrbit: one shared rover and one orbit to escape
slides.lead: Land, salvage, defend, launch. Then do it again.

slides.heading: Each friend runs one seat, so nobody waits for a turn

slides.body:
Driver, gunner, engineer, navigator.
Every seat is busy every second.

slides.heading: Every sortie ends at 20 minutes, win or lose
slides.lead: Four phases, one timer, no grind between runs.

slides.heading: Friends drop into a sortie from one Discord link

Click the card, take the open seat.
No party codes, no lobby screen.
